gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-lisu-bosa: Pramukh Rounded packs its soft, tightly bunched letters close together, with barely any gap between them. Lisu Bosa, the classic serif, goes the other way, with tall, sturdy lowercase and a modest thick-thin shift.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-major-mono-dis:
Major Mono Display looks like neon tubing, with generous space around every glyph.

Over a long passage the monospace letters would feel spaced out and deliberate, each one standing alone, while Pramukh Rounded keeps the headline tight and friendly above.
gen-fs-pramukh-rounded-gf-victor-mono: Victor Mono reads loose and magnified, its monospace bowls left slightly open on one side. Pramukh Rounded fits snugly above it, drawn with little thick-thin shift, so the tight headline and the spacious text make a tidy, structured contrast.
gen-fs-quilon-fs-trench-slab: Quilon flows from thick to thin in a restrained rhythm, with big open counters in its tall a, e and s. Trench Slab, a classic serif, keeps the gap between lowercase and caps minimal, so its text feels dignified and compact line after line.
gen-fs-rajdhani-gf-kiwi-maru: Kiwi Maru reads with generous letterspace, its text serif terminals stopping well short of the stem and its o a ring of constant wall. Rajdhani sits above it as a modern, clean sans-serif whose curves match its stems, giving the pair a crisp tension.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-marcellus-sc: Marcellus SC reads dignified and literary, its classic serif lowercase standing tall with gentle modulation and terminals pulled back. Red Hat Display is best at bold, marker-like lines with no shading, but Marcellus SC does its finest work in quiet, graceful letters.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-scope-one: Bold and contemporary, Red Hat Display draws a marker-like line with visible daylight inside every curve. Scope One counters it with a classic serif look, its big x-height and stubby ascenders giving the text a sturdy, traditional feel beneath the heading.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-slabo-13px:
Marker-bold and wide open.

Red Hat Display holds one steady pen width throughout, while Slabo 13px adds a bookish serif with large open counters, so the heading shouts and the text settles in.
gen-gf-autour-one-fs-spline-sans: Round, loud and expressive, Autour One flows straight into each curve with no hairline shifts. Spline Sans, the plain sans here, offers wide gaps between curve ends and stems, and that approachable openness is what the pair does best.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-aclonica: Aclonica reads in a long, stretched-out line of widely spaced letters, with a deep midsection in its lowercase. Over a longer passage Aclonica would feel steady and wide, while Autour One keeps its curves thick all the way to the shoulders.
